terminalSettings.autocompleteDescription: Enable phone-style autocomplete, autocorrect, and spelling suggestions in the terminal command bar. Off by default so the keyboard never rewrites commands, flags, or paths. Direct keyboard input (when keys go straight to the terminal) always sends raw keystrokes, so suggestions don't apply there.
terminalSettings.textScaleDescription: Scale the terminal text. Smaller sizes fit more columns with side margins; larger sizes show fewer columns — drag sideways to pan. You can also pinch to zoom in the terminal itself, which updates this setting. Per-device display only; doesn't change the desktop terminal.
terminalSettings.no: No paired desktops yet. Pair one to control terminal behavior.
terminalSettings.resizeBehaviorDescription: While you're using a terminal on your phone, Orca shrinks it to fit your screen. When you close the app or switch away, this controls whether it stays at phone size (so interactive CLI tools don't reflow) or resizes back to your desktop. You can always use Restore this terminal or Restore all terminals on the banner to resize manually.
